hypotheses.G1_readable_grammar_is_causally_useful: At least one independently fit 21-leaf grammar reaches 0.93 six-layer KL recovery.
hypotheses.G2_readable_grammar_is_competitive_with_: At least one grammar is within 0.03 KL recovery of the human-category program.
hypotheses.G3_new_lexical_primitives_are_selected: At least three of the twenty splits use newly added whitespace, continuation, length, byte, or frequency predicates.
hypotheses.G4_grammar_variables_are_split_stable: Independent grammar assignments have frequency-weighted NMI at least 0.60.
hypotheses.G5_readable_grammar_is_prediction_useful: At least one grammar reaches 0.70 native top-1 agreement.
hypotheses.G6_readable_grammar_beats_embedding_clus: At least one grammar exceeds exact-embedding cluster recovery by at least 0.05.
